notes.title: 2025/06/02 1.2.0 Update Notice
notes.content:
Update was made on 2025/06/02 to fix bugs and other issues.

Contents of update
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where GPU utilization increased too much in some environments.
[*] Font adjustment
[*] Other minor issues
[/list]

Please be sure to update your system before playing.
We hope you continue to enjoy LINGKARAN.

notes.title: LINGKARAN　Released!!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45363303/5b73e9fffaa89be6389e635832ae7f8af8f7b5a4.jpg[/img]
A mystery adventure game where you escape from the endless sea. Players investigate an island where the scenery remains the same no matter how far they walk, and unravel the mystery of the fragmented memories they gradually remember. Uncover the truth and aim to escape from the mysterious island.

notes.title: LINGKARAN: Demo Update
notes.content:
This update brings the demo content in line with what will be in the full release.
If you’ve already played the previous version, the core content remains the same, but we’ve added new graphics and scenes.
We hope you’ll enjoy the updated demo while you wait a little longer for the full release!
